description: This Java source file defines the FilePath class, which provides utility methods for handling file paths, including resolving absolute paths, generating URLs, expanding glob patterns, and internal file/directory traversal with logging.

classes.name: FilePath
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods for file path resolution, URL creation, glob expansion, and internal file/directory traversal with logging.

classes.name: FilePath.Finder
classes.description: Inner class extending SimpleFileVisitor to find files and directories matching a pattern during file tree traversal.

methods.name: absolutePathFromClassPathOrPath
methods.description: Returns the absolute path of a resource or file given its filename, resolving from class loader if necessary.

methods.name: getURL
methods.description: Creates a URL object from a file path if it exists, otherwise attempts to load as a resource.

methods.name: expandFilePathGlobs
methods.description: Expands glob patterns in file paths to matching file paths, including resource scanning with ClassGraph.
